summary: A sprawling four-domain session — shopping (Evan Parker), two airline customers (Olivia Bennett, Megan Carter), and a hotel cancellation (Elena Brooks) — across 13 turns. T1–T2 review six promotions and correctly reject the expired FALL15SAVE code via the system's expiry check; T3–T6 pull reservation D3A184, recite the full baggage policy, and add one paid bag (+$50) behind a confirmation gate; T7–T8 book a new flight for Megan, pausing to check whether the tool requires a missing DOB; T9 caps the LogiTech mouse at the 3-unit per-product limit; T10–T12 apply PROMO0F1B01, refuse an out-of-window exchange and a final-sale return, confirm the no-stacking rule, and cancel hotel HR-68D9. Both probe turns are RECALL+APPLY: T2 recalls the cart and promo and applies the expiry policy, and T9 recalls the mouse already in the cart and applies the quantity cap ("3 LogiTech mice (max allowed)"). The run's hallmark is policy-as-checklist: expiry windows, stacking rules, return windows, and quantity limits are each read off and enforced.
